# BoostHub — Social Media Growth Services (LLMs.txt)

BoostHub is an original static HTML/CSS/JavaScript SMM panel storefront with Indian Rupee (₹ INR) pricing, UPI-style demo wallet, Firebase Realtime Database integration, and a Creator Premium admin panel.

## Base URL
https://boosthub-seven.vercel.app

## Pages
- / — Home: Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube service catalog
- /instagram/ — Instagram services (followers, views, likes, saves)
- /facebook/ — Facebook services (page followers, post likes, views, groups)
- /youtube/ — YouTube services (views, subscribers, likes, watch hours)
- /order/ — Place a demo order with wallet checkout
- /orders/ — Order history and tracking
- /addfunds/ — UPI-style demo wallet deposit
- /menu/ — Account menu and demo data management
- /chat/ — Support chat assistant
- /share/ — Referral and sharing page
- /install/ — PWA installation instructions
- /terms/ — Terms of service
- /privacy-policy/ — Privacy policy
- /admin/ — Creator Premium admin panel (services, orders, users, Firebase DB)
- /404/ — Custom 404 page

## Firebase
Project ID: hiiii-72d78
Realtime Database used for admin panel data sync.

## Currency
₹ (Indian Rupee / INR)

## Contact
support@boosthub.example
